title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
summary: Artificial intelligence platforms may be just as susceptible to social engineering as human beings, but they are proving remarkably good at finding security vulnerabilities in human-made computer code. title: Immutable Strings in Java – Are Your Secrets Still Safe?
